race.comment: PLAYIN'IT SWEET (10) had her chance in the Crawford, getting into the clear and making her attack before ending up 0.9L off HOT AND HIGH. She'll be fitter for that run though and getting out to 1400m is a big tick for her chances. Gets a good weight swing in her favour and can turn the tables on HOT AND HIGH (4) who picked up from where she had left off. Had the dream run in the Crawford, getting up on the fence and winning by 0.6L and this looks to shape similarly. She was a narrow winner of the Raconteur in her only try at this trip and there's no reason why she can't repeat the dose. AWESOME BOY (7) rattled home between horses in the Crawford to jag second and is another with a weight swing in his favour. Out to 1400m is a big tick and he can't be left out of calculations. BONJOY (1) is known to strike second-up and looks primed for a bold showing. HURRICANE HARLEY (8) is racing well and is worth including in multiples.
